title: The Gell–Mann–Brueckner Formula in the Thermodynamic Limit
exact_target: Prove the predicted high-density correlation-energy formula for the electron gas after taking its thermodynamic limit.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006483 (OWR-14299579-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Arbeitsgemeinschaft: Analysis of Many-body Quantum Systems (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/46, pp. 2491--2544. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The report distinguishes proved mean-field results on a fixed torus from the open thermodynamic-limit problem. The two limits and their coupling conventions must not be interchanged.
